about: Colofac (mebeverine), by brand name only, is supplied eight times from January to August 2026 to a 68-year-old woman.
Colese (mebeverine) is supplied three times from 18 December 2025 to 19 February 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, to a 72-year-old man.
The only antispasmodic is Buscopan (hyoscine butylbromide), which is not on the list and which the source names as an alternative, so the criterion is not met.
